title: Edit Distance
statement_md:
Given two strings `word1` and `word2`, return the minimum number of operations required to convert `word1` to `word2`.

You have the following three operations permitted on a word:
- Insert a character
- Delete a character
- Replace a character

hints.text: Define dp[i][j] as minimum operations to convert word1[:i] to word2[:j].
Otherwise, dp[i][j] = 1 + min(insert: dp[i][j-1], delete: dp[i-1][j], replace: dp[i-1][j-1]).
